content.title: How to watch Braves vs. Phillies: TV channel and streaming options for April 19
content.text: The Atlanta Braves bring a four-game winning streak into a road contest versus the Philadelphia Phillies at 7:20 p.m. ET on Sunday. Grant Holmes (1-1, 3.32 ERA) will start for the Braves, who are 14-7 this season and first in the NL East. Andrew Painter (1-0, 3.77 ERA) is expected to start for the Phillies, who are 8-12 and fourth in the NL East.How to watch Atlanta Braves vs. Philadelphia Phillies Venue: Citizens Bank Park Time: 7:20 p.m. ET TV: Peacock Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Realmuto: day-to-day (Back)Stats to know Atlanta’s Drake Baldwin has hit five home runs this season, which ranks 20th in MLB. He has also tallied 19 RBIs (4th in MLB) and has scored 21 runs. In 96 plate appearances, he has recorded a .318 BA, .375 OBP and .523 SLG with a 6.3% walk rate and a 17.7% strikeout rate. In 94 plate appearances, Matt Olson has hit five long balls (20th in MLB), tallied 15 RBIs and scored 17 runs (12th in MLB). He is batting .296/.394/.605 and has posted a 26.6% strikeout rate and a 13.8% walk rate. Philadelphia’s Bryce Harper is slashing .270/.357/.527 this season with four home runs, 11 RBIs and an OPS of .884. He has a 16.7% strikeout rate and an 11.9% walk rate in 84 plate appearances, and he has scored 10 total runs. In 87 plate appearances, Trea Turner has posted a 19.5% strikeout rate and a 6.9% walk rate while slashing .259/.310/.383 with two home runs, seven RBIs and 13 runs scored. He has stolen two bases on two attempts.
